method: Built-in imagegen independent complete original drawings.
referencePurpose: Private Q still images constrain hoof locations and camera only; complete calf is repainted in original poster low-poly style.

frames.fullPrompt:
Create ONE SINGLE full-body original animation drawing of the exact BABY black-white calf from reference image2, in the complete four-leg POSE of reference image1. This is not a sprite atlas or video.
Image1 is ONLY the animator's static pose sketch: match its exact camera/view, body/head anchor, overall proportions and all FOUR hoof-tip positions. Preserve each limb's near/far identity by tracing its shoulder/hip to its hoof. Near foreleg attaches to the visible outer shoulder, far foreleg behind it. Their foot x offsets from the shoulder MUST follow this particular pose 0, not the standing pose in image2. All four hooves are complete; far hooves may naturally overlap but cannot disappear from anatomy.
Image2 is only original IDENTITY and ART STYLE: same friendly face, eye/ear shape, body proportions, natural colors/markings, low-poly faceted sculpted dimensional shading. For babies preserve large cute eyes, oversized head and short leg proportions. Do not add any new style or photorealism.
Completely REDRAW all anatomy in pose1, with naturally bending elbows/wrists, knees/hocks and seamless continuous skin/wool. REMOVE the horizontal cutout seams, jagged joint fragments and rectangular hoof/leg remnants from the pose sketch. Do not paste its legs or let hooves become rectangular flippers. Natural compact cloven hooves attached properly. Keep the four hoof CONTACT CENTER LOCATIONS from image1, but restore smooth anatomically valid silhouette. The whole torso/head and camera stay same registration, no centering each silhouette anew.
Landscape/portrait canvas ratio MATCHES image1 exactly, preferably high resolution, same generous margins. Transparent RGBA with clean antialiasing, no background specks/noise/fringes. No floor, grass, cast shadows, scenery, props, text, colored skeletal/guide lines, borders or labels. Entire character faces LEFT and fits inside canvas. One fully redrawn connected animal, precise limb phase, consistent original low-poly style.

checks.fourConnectedLegs: Four connected legs present in all poses. Phase 0 far hind hoof partly occluded naturally by near hind hoof, rather than missing limb.
checks.forelegExchange: Near foretoe moves from back in 0 to forward in 4; phase 2 has the near fore hoof and far hind hoof lifted. Phase 6 is the opposite support transition.
checks.style: Consistent baby black/cream low-poly calf, friendly brown eyes, peach muzzle. No colored skeletal guide leakage.
checks.camera: All 1318 x 1193 source canvases correspond to 583 x 528 guide canvas. Entire-frame normalization only.
checks.limitations: Four main keys, not an eight-frame fully articulated run. Slight normal head bob and facet changes remain; full playback QA still required.

footQA.coordinateSpace: Manual approximate source-pixel toe centers, not inferred shoulder animation.
footQA.confidence: High for toe identity, medium for wool/skin shoulder attachment location.

approvedScope: Art and limb continuity; root runtime review pending
